How well do peripheral blood B-cell measurements track tissue B cells, and
how well does a biopsy from one tissue describe what is happening in another?
The initial focus is depletion and recovery after B-cell-directed therapy in
autoimmune disease, including the sampling and assay limits of a negative biopsy.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). The questions, measurement
  definitions, evidence requirements and planned analysis.
- [References](references.qmd). The five studies in the initial review, their
  verification status and the questions to resolve in each.
- [Supplied evidence brief](evidence-brief.qmd). The review received on
  21 September 2026, preserved as the starting record.
